note: Stories for Connecting the Dots. Women: the New York memorial entries from Sex Industry Kills, and records from the public record (Queens 2026, Gilgo Beach, Rochester 1988 to 1989) with the sources that could be read. Jane Doe figures stand for the uncounted. No review text, no generated faces.

women.name: Cecilia Gentili
women.meta: age 52 · February 6 2024 · New York City, New York
women.cause: died of an overdose · trans woman
women.text: Cecilia’s parents were Italian and Argentinian. Cecilia was sexually abused by a neighbor throughout the childhood, beginning at age 6. Cecilia came out as gay at age 12 and started identifying as a woman in the early 20s, at age 26 deciding to move to the United States in search of a better life. After leaving Argentina, Cecilia lived in Brazil and later being banned from there, Cecilia never divulged why.

women.name: Judy Guzman
women.meta: age 54 · October 18 2019 · New York City, New York
women.text: Judy died from a drug overdose.

women.name: Chrystel Yager
women.meta: age 38 · July 8 2018 · Poughkeepsie, New York
women.text: Chrystel was mother of a daughter. She was advertised for prostitution purposes on Backpage and charged with „promoting prostitution“ since 2015.

women.name: Leondra Foster
women.meta: age 32 · January 17 2017 · New York City, New York
women.text: Leondra was mother of a 16 year old. She was once in a relationship with Somorie Moses, but when she tried to leave, he threatened to kill her. Leondra was beaten to death by Moses who was her pimp. He decided to conceal her remains instead of contacting the police. The following morning, using a knife and a saw, Moses dismembered her body inside their shared apartment in Brooklyn, New York.

women.name: Melissa Barthelemy
women.meta: age 24 · July 12 2009 · Bronx, New York City, New York
women.text: Melissa grew up in upstate New York, graduated in Buffalo and after school got her cosmetology license. At the age of 20 she left to live in the Bronx. She lived in a tiny apartment together with her five cats. She dreamed of having her own business and wanted to make money for this purpose.She advertised on Craigslist offering sexual service for money.

women.name: Colleen McNamee
women.meta: age 20 · January 5 1994 · Long Island, New York
women.text: Colleen at school was known as a bubbly peacemaker in Sachem High School on Long Island, dressing impeccably. She could be heard in hallways imploring friends in a squeaky voice to stop fighting or sleeping in class. Colleen was reported missing by her parents one day after she was last seen. According to her mother, she was bipolar and struggling with a drug addiction and was in prostitution.

women.name: Carmen Vargas
women.meta: age 29 · summer 1989 · New York City, New York
women.text: Carmen was last seen getting into a dark car with a man in Harlem. Carmens‘ remains would be found at the side of the road along the Meadowbrook State Parkway, in Freeport, weeks later on September 11. Her ankles and wrists were bound with a cord. A towel covered her face, a rope was tied around her neck, and she was missing three of her front teeth.

women.title: The Penn Track
women.text: An open-air sex market where police estimate 350 pimps operate. Omari Scott was convicted in 2025 of murder in the course of sex trafficking and sentenced to 50 years; Joel Forney of trafficking two women there.
women.named: Named as “sex trafficking”; the murder victim counted is a pimp, the women are witnesses.

women.title: Sayville Motor Lodge
women.text: Michael Johnson, convicted October 2025, sentenced April 2026 to 22 years for trafficking women out of a motel: coercion, drugs, violence, a room.
women.named: Named as “sex trafficking of women”; no category for the women who die.

women.title: Gilgo Beach
women.text: Rex Heuermann, arrested July 2023, charged with the murders of women found along the beach, several of whom advertised as escorts. Reported for a decade through the lens of their work.
women.named: Named as “sex workers”, “escorts”, “the Craigslist killer”. Rarely “women”.

women.name: Shao Ling Huang
women.meta: age 39 · 6 November 2026 · Flushing, Queens, New York City
women.text: Shao Ling Huang was killed inside the massage parlor where she worked, at 36-17 164th Street in Flushing, between 3:50 and 4:15 in the afternoon. Another worker who went to check on her found her at 4:24 p.m. The Department of Buildings had received a complaint the day before about an illegal adult establishment at the premises. Zhordrack Blodywon, 54, was arrested three days later and arraigned on 11 November 2026 on a complaint charging first-degree murder, two counts of second-degree murder, first-degree robbery, second-degree burglary, first-degree sexual abuse and weapon possession. He was remanded. The case is open.

women.name: Maureen Brainard-Barnes
women.meta: age 25 · last heard from 9 July 2007 · Norwich, Connecticut, and Manhattan
women.text: A mother of two from Norwich, Connecticut, who travelled to Manhattan for a few days at a time and advertised on Craigslist, Backpage and other sites. Her last call, at 11:43 p.m. on 9 July 2007, told a friend she was going to meet someone outside a motel. Her remains were found on 13 December 2010 on the north side of Ocean Parkway near Gilgo Beach, during the search for Shannan Gilbert. Rex Heuermann was arrested in July 2023. On 8 April 2026 he pleaded guilty to seven counts of murder and admitted killing Karen Vergata as part of the plea, prosecutors said.

women.name: Megan Waterman
women.meta: age 22 · last seen 6 June 2010 · Hauppauge, Long Island
women.text: Megan Waterman was last seen on surveillance video leaving a Holiday Inn Express in Hauppauge, about 25 miles north of where her remains were found, not long after connecting with someone through Craigslist. Her remains were found near Gilgo Beach in December 2010. Prosecutors said hair found with her remains matched DNA from a pizza box discarded outside Rex Heuermann's Manhattan office. Rex Heuermann was arrested in July 2023. On 8 April 2026 he pleaded guilty to seven counts of murder and admitted killing Karen Vergata as part of the plea, prosecutors said.

women.name: Amber Lynn Costello
women.meta: age 27 · disappeared on or about 2 September 2010 · Babylon, Long Island
women.text: Amber Lynn Costello disappeared from Babylon, minutes from Gilgo Beach. Her last known meeting was arranged through a burner phone. Her remains were found near Gilgo Beach in December 2010 with those of three other women who had advertised on Craigslist. Rex Heuermann was arrested in July 2023. On 8 April 2026 he pleaded guilty to seven counts of murder and admitted killing Karen Vergata as part of the plea, prosecutors said.

women.name: Sandra Costilla
women.meta: age 28 · killed 19 or 20 November 1993 · Southampton, Long Island
women.text: Sandra Costilla, from Trinidad and Tobago, was living on Gates Avenue in Ridgewood, Queens. Hunters found her body in 1993 in a wooded area of Southampton. In June 2024 Rex Heuermann was charged with her murder, three decades after her death. Rex Heuermann was arrested in July 2023. On 8 April 2026 he pleaded guilty to seven counts of murder and admitted killing Karen Vergata as part of the plea, prosecutors said.

women.name: Valerie Mack
women.meta: killed in 2000 · Manorville and Gilgo Beach, Long Island
women.text: Valerie Mack was killed in the spring or summer of 2000. Her partial remains were found in Manorville and near Gilgo Beach. Rex Heuermann was charged with her murder in December 2024. Rex Heuermann was arrested in July 2023. On 8 April 2026 he pleaded guilty to seven counts of murder and admitted killing Karen Vergata as part of the plea, prosecutors said.

women.name: Jessica Taylor
women.meta: age 20 · disappeared July 2003 · Manhattan and Poughkeepsie
women.text: Jessica Taylor was working as an escort in Midtown Manhattan. She spoke with her mother by phone before leaving for what would be her last date, and never arrived in Poughkeepsie for her mother's birthday on 25 July 2003. Her dismembered body was found in 2011 in the scrub near Ocean Parkway, east of Gilgo Beach; other remains were found in Manorville. Rex Heuermann was charged with her murder in June 2024. Rex Heuermann was arrested in July 2023. On 8 April 2026 he pleaded guilty to seven counts of murder and admitted killing Karen Vergata as part of the plea, prosecutors said.

women.name: Karen Vergata
women.meta: age 34 · disappeared 1996 · Manhattan and Fire Island
women.text: Karen Vergata, from Manhattan, disappeared in 1996 and was believed to be working as an escort. Her legs and feet were found on the bay side of Fire Island in April 1996; she was known as Fire Island Jane Doe for years. Fifteen years later more of her remains were found at Tobay Beach. She was identified in August 2023. Rex Heuermann admitted killing her as part of his April 2026 plea, prosecutors said.

women.name: Dorothy Blackburn
women.meta: age 27 · disappeared 18 March 1988 · found 24 March 1988 · Rochester, New York
women.text: Dorothy Blackburn disappeared on 18 March 1988 and was found on 24 March 1988. She was one of the women Arthur Shawcross killed in Rochester in 1988 and 1989. Arthur Shawcross was paroled in April 1987 after serving 14 years of a 25-year sentence for killing two children in Watertown in 1972. From March 1988 he killed women in the Rochester area, primarily targeting women in prostitution, driving the streets in his girlfriend's car. He was tried in Monroe County in November 1990 for ten murders and convicted; Elizabeth Gibson was killed in neighbouring Wayne County. He was sentenced to 250 years and died in custody on 10 November 2008.
sources: Arthur Shawcross, Wikipedia, with its cited court and press record

men.text: The largest market and the largest gap. Brooklyn patronizing arrests fell from 279 in 2018 to 28 in 2020. Manhattan made 107 buyer arrests in 2011 against more than 400 in Nashville. A 2018 NYPD officer ran a $2 million-a-year ring across Queens, Brooklyn and Long Island; 49 men were arrested in Operation Zap. Flushing's illicit massage parlours are named in the report as a centre of demand.
Sayville Motor Lodge and Gilgo Beach are both here. The 2018 Operation Zap ring extended onto the island. Reviews cluster along the Nassau and Suffolk corridors.

In 2021 a Hudson Valley police officer was arrested for an eight-year sex trafficking and bribery operation between Mexico, Queens and Brewster. An Orange County sting arrested four women and three buyers.

Safe Inc. in Schenectady reports that 90% of the roughly 1,000 homeless young people it works with each year have been approached by a pimp or exploiter. Five arrests in Saratoga Springs in the FBI's Operation Cross Country, 2013.
Buffalo and Jamestown. In 2017 Rochester police arrested 15 men for patronizing after a "Dear John" billboard campaign pressed them to enforce Section 230 of the Penal Law.

Rochester's "Dear John" campaign posted buyers' pictures on billboards. The region is also where Arthur Shawcross killed women in prostitution; the report cites it as history that was never named as femicide.
Syracuse police ran a reverse sting online and arrested 20 buyers, many from out of town. In 2020 three men were arrested, one for luring a 12-year-old on social media.
Utica: arrests of women in prostitution in 2015 and 2016, with no recorded arrests of sex buyers found by the report.

Interstate 87 between Montreal and New York City raises trafficking risk. State police arrested 5 buyers in Calcium in 2014 and 10 men for solicitation in 2016. Plattsburgh officials reported rising child exploitation tied to the opiate crisis.
Binghamton and Elmira. Few reviews, and the report finds few enforcement actions to set against them.

jane: Jane Doe. A woman killed in the sex trade whose name is not in any public record. Her figure is an estimate: no government or agency in the United States or New York counts the women and girls killed by sex buyers, pimps and traffickers, so we might never actually know who she was, or how many there are.

observations.note: The variables of the first version of the game, kept as observations. Ladders were the actions that close the holes; chutes the conditions that widen them.
ladders: Pass the Survivors Justice and Equality Act
Target the sites where buyers post
Value women and girls as equals
End the normalisation in media and film
chutes: Dehumanisation of women in the trade
